stop_if: Any change is needed outside allowed_files, including package manifests, lockfile, generated output, content, ingestion, provenance, search, raw routes, plans, snapshots, infrastructure, or external systems.
Any lockfile refresh, peer override, hidden install, registry replacement, or unrelated dependency churn is proposed.

Any fixture, sibling-local, future Git-imported, or otherwise untrusted document would cross the Fumadocs renderer or execute MDX imports, exports, unsafe HTML, URLs, network access, or source-shadowing behavior.
Existing public routes, content, ingestion, provenance, static search, raw routes, SEO, security headers, or zero-advisory posture regresses.
Visual verification requires updating snapshots or generated artifacts to hide a regression.
A verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause, a browser server collides with an unrelated process, or evidence cannot be refreshed truthfully.
